channel.title: Jlisten2me Journal
channel.description: Articles on carrying things you can't hand to the people around you.

item.title: When you're looking for a new job and haven't told anyone at home
item.description: You're interviewing quietly, hiding it at work and at home until there's an offer. Somewhere to say it out loud first.

item.title: When you promised your mom you'd never put her in a home
item.description: You promised you'd never move her into a home, and now she's in memory care. The relief and the guilt show up together.

item.title: When you're not sure you can make payroll
item.description: Checking the bank balance before every payday, covering the gap yourself, and nobody you can tell. Somewhere to say it out loud.

item.title: When you're getting divorced and your friends are picking sides
item.description: You're getting divorced, mutual friends have gone quiet or drifted to your ex, and the invitations stopped. Somewhere to say it.

item.title: When you have to decide and can't tell anyone yet
item.description: A decision about layoffs, runway, or selling, and everyone you'd normally tell has a stake in it. Somewhere to say it first.
